synthesizedAndOriginalCode.what: sound('hit'): WebAudio sine blip for hit confirmation (not a BO2 recording).
survivalSound(): sawtooth/triangle oscillator sweeps for board, repair and breach.
Web Audio mixer, spatialisation and reconstructed reload/bolt timing around BO2 WAVs (code original, samples BO2).
sign(): canvas-drawn name/price plates and a simple box collision cabinet; BO2 GLB mesh/textures are fitted over it by src/perk-models.js.
Procedural timber boards, gates, carts/crates and a generated wood texture (Box geometry).
Reconstructed animated water surface, streams and spray fitted to WoW fountain placements.
Killstreak sentry is a handful of box meshes with tracer fire; BO2-inspired concept, no BO2 asset.
UAV is radar-reveal logic on a 2D canvas; no model or audio.
createZeppelin(): procedural stand-in shown until the real WoW zeppelin (src/zeppelin-model.js) finishes loading.
Battle Royale storm/zone visuals (README: original prototype visuals).
Procedural sway, recoil, reload and knife swing; no BO2 animation clips (weapons/provenance.json).
All CSS/HTML; system fonts only; cod-theme.css imitates a CoD-style HUD with original code and no CoD image or font files.

designRule.statement: CoD owns the combat layer (guns, gun/FX audio, perk machines, sentry/UAV concepts, HUD style). WoW owns the world layer (cities, props, races, zombies/ghouls, zeppelin). ORIGINAL code fills gaps and glues them together.

findings.item: Hit-confirmation sound is a synthesized sine blip
findings.detail: Combat-layer audio that is not CoD.
findings.recommendation: Extract a BO2 hitmarker alias (mpl_common.all family) with scripts/import-audio.ps1, or document the blip as intentional.

findings.item: Survival barricade/board/breach sounds are oscillator sweeps
findings.detail: Zombies combat feedback is synthesized (README admits it).
findings.recommendation: Import BO2 zombie barricade aliases (zm banks) or keep and label as placeholder.

findings.item: Sentry and UAV have no CoD presentation
findings.detail: Sentry is box meshes; UAV is a radar reveal only.
findings.recommendation: Import a BO2 sentry model (named-model path used by import-cod-props.ps1) and UAV/sentry alias audio. Another agent may be adding sentry assets; classify any new folder in this table.

findings.item: Perk machines mix CoD mesh with original signage
findings.detail: BO2 GLB (combat) placed inside WoW cities; canvas sign() and box collider are original and remain as fallback.
findings.recommendation: Keep: mesh and textures are CoD, collision and fallback are original code. Prefer the BO2 logo textures already bundled over canvas text.

findings.item: Zeppelin placeholder vs real WoW zeppelin
findings.detail: README says both that Battle Royale uses the original Wrath hull and that the zeppelin is an original prototype visual.
findings.recommendation: Fix README wording: the WoW hull is the product; the procedural zeppelin is only a loading stand-in.

findings.item: Procedural fortifications and fountain water inside the WoW world layer
findings.detail: World-layer visuals that are original rather than WoW.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable. Where practical swap carts/crates for imported WoW doodads (props/).

findings.item: Playable races and zombies are WoW meshes carrying BO2 guns
findings.detail: Intended hybrid: WoW actors in the world, CoD weapons in hand. Hit regions are approximated by height.
findings.recommendation: Keep; this is the project premise.

findings.item: public/ui menu art is a rendered mix
findings.detail: In-game screenshots may contain WoW geometry plus CoD models or HUD.
findings.recommendation: Treat as non-redistributable (git-ignored). Regenerate with capture-menu-art.cjs if provenance matters.

findings.detail: Code is original (MIT) but visually evokes CoD; no CoD files are included.
findings.recommendation: Fine for a parody project; do not add CoD logos or fonts.

findings.item: Layouts saved under public/assets/layouts/ are ORIGINAL data inside an ignored folder
findings.detail: public/assets/ is git-ignored, so user layouts are never committed.
findings.recommendation: Move layouts to a tracked location if sharing them is wanted.
